name: Porakhuy svoyi kroky
source:
Count your steps

Reading the title of the novel, you won't immediately realize what it's about. 

Only after following Zoryana's path will you realize how much a single misunderstanding can change a girl's fate.

[translated from [url=https://fazan-games.itch.io/count-your-steps]itch.io[/url]]
